# Multimodal and voice

English · [Русский](../ru/themes/multimodal-voice.md) · ← [AI Interview Atlas](../../README.md)

Vision-language models, real-time voice agents, speech quality and multimodal retrieval.

## Both tracks

- **Compare a speech-recognition, text-model and speech-synthesis pipeline with an end-to-end speech-to-speech model.**
  - Knowledge
  - Tests: Whether latency, controllability and paralinguistic information shape the choice.

## AI Engineering

- **Compare projection layers, cross-attention and token-based integration for giving a language model access to images.**
  - Knowledge · Asked at: [Meta](../companies/meta.md) †
  - Tests: Whether image encoding is separated from cross-modal fusion.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Separate the vision encoder from the interface to the language model.
    - Compare projected image tokens with cross-attention to visual features.
    - Discuss visual token budget, spatial detail and training alignment.
  - Read: [Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.14198) (Alayrac et al., arXiv)
- **What architectural and data choices change when a vision-language model must reason over video rather than isolated images?**
  - Knowledge · Asked at: [Meta](../companies/meta.md) †
  - Tests: Whether temporal information and sampling cost are addressed.
- **Build an end-to-end latency budget for a voice agent, from detecting the end of speech to playing its reply.**
  - System design
  - Tests: Whether turn detection, ASR, generation, synthesis and transport all appear in the budget.
- **Design interruption handling when a user starts speaking while the agent's audio is still playing.**
  - System design
  - Tests: Whether playback cancellation and conversational state remain consistent.
- **How would you evaluate speech recognition beyond word error rate and synthetic speech when many renditions are acceptable?**
  - Applied scenario
  - Tests: Whether task-critical errors and perceptual quality are measured separately.
- **How would you improve and evaluate speech recognition for mixed-language utterances and different accents?**
  - Applied scenario
  - Tests: Whether subgroup coverage and domain errors are visible in evaluation.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Build evaluation slices for languages, accents, noise and code-switching.
    - Inspect entity and task-critical errors alongside aggregate word error rate.
    - Validate any adaptation on held-out speakers and domains to detect regressions.
  - Read: [Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.04356) (Radford et al., arXiv)
- **How would you choose speech synthesis chunk boundaries and playback buffering under variable network delay?**
  - System design
  - Tests: Whether prosody, first-audio latency and playback continuity are balanced.
- **Design speaker diarisation and explain how you would assign conversational roles without assuming speaker clusters imply identity.**
  - System design
  - Tests: Whether segmentation, clustering and role inference are distinguished.
- **Design search across text, images and video, including how queries and results share a comparable representation.**
  - System design
  - Tests: Whether cross-modal alignment and retrieval granularity are explicit.
- **How would you prepare numbers, abbreviations and ambiguous written forms for speech synthesis without changing their meaning?**
  - Applied scenario
  - Tests: Whether text normalisation handles context-sensitive pronunciation.
- **Design a dubbing pipeline that preserves speaker identity and fits translated speech into the original video's timing.**
  - System design
  - Tests: Whether translation, alignment and audio quality are jointly constrained.
- **How would you improve recognition in a noisy consultation with overlapping speakers and specialised medical vocabulary?**
  - Applied scenario
  - Tests: Whether noise, overlap and rare terminology have separate diagnostics.
- **What distinguishes a vision-language-action policy from a language model that merely invokes external tools?**
  - Knowledge
  - Tests: Whether action representation and control feedback are distinguished.
